newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Hank out of hosptial after stroke - TV.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Hank out of hosptial after stroke - TV.

text.p: Carlos Hank Gonzalez, a top figure in Mexican politics over three decades who suffered a stroke on Sunday, was released from the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, Minnesota, a television report said on Wednesday.
Hank is staying at a nearby hotel while further tests are conducted at the world-famous clinic, Television Azteca said.
Hank, 70, who has held a series of high-level government jobs and is a leading conservative within Mexico's ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI), is in stable condition, TV Azteca said.
Hank has been mayor of Mexico City, governor of Mexico state and has held several cabinet posts. He retired from politics in 1994.
